name: YouTube Music
author: nicolasfalesy (built on Omarchy's Media widget)
description: Full remote for the YouTube Music desktop app (pear-desktop): now playing, up next, search, library and playlists, queue, like, shuffle, repeat, volume, and word-by-word lyrics. Starts the app in the background on demand and quits it when idle.

barWidget.description: Equalizer plus the song. Click for the full panel; right click play/pause; middle click next.
